answer_4.quote: We conduct a human study to assess the viability of the adversarial attacks. More specifically, we provide machine learning graduate students 250 input examples and ask the following questions: (a) What is the perceived label of the sentence; (b) What is their confidence about this label; and (c) Was this sentence adversarially manipulated?
